subject: Next steps: Compliance priorities & milestone commitments
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@silvergatepayments.com>
Cc: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@silvergatepayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Compliance priorities & milestone commitments

Elena / Marco —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through how SilverGate is thinking about inspection/retention requirements and what you need from an inferring partner. Quick recap of what I heard and the commitments we proposed: 

Key pain points you raised:
- SOC 2 readiness is a gating item for procurement; you need a clear mapping of artifacts and timelines.
- Audit log retention: legal needs a 7-year retention plan for certain event classes; ops wants near-real-time exportability.
- DPA/contract terms: procurement will require specific retention, deletion, and subprocessor transparency clauses.
- Pen test & evidentiary artifacts: you want a list of what Redwood can provide (config diffs, pen-test reports, remediation timelines).

What Redwood committed to deliver by next touch: 
1) A one-page SOC 2 artifact map tied to the control families + the likely delivery dates (target: 10 business days).
2) An exportable audit-log schema and a short runbook for retention/export (target: 7 business days).
3) A DPA draft with highlighted retention and subprocessor sections for procurement to review (target: 5 business days).
4) A list of available pen-test artifacts and a recommended cadence (we can provide recent reports and a playbook for evidence intake) (target: 5 business days).

Immediate asks for your team (could you confirm these by reply?):
- Which event classes must retain 7 years vs 1 year? (examples: transaction metadata, full request payloads, anonymized telemetry)
- Who should ownership of artifact intake be on your side (legal/procurement/infosec)?
- Any mandatory format for evidence (PDF report, raw logs, signed attestations)?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level mapping), evidence-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet to capture artifacts).

Proposed next touch: 2027-06-14 at 10:00 PT for a 30-min follow-up to review the artifact map and DPA highlights. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

On Mon, 7 Jun 2027 at 14:33 Elena Torres <elena@silvergatepayments.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sofia — great convo. I’ll pull in procurement and IT risk.
> 
> — Elena
From: Elena Torres <elena@silvergatepayments.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@silvergatepayments.com>, procurement@silvergatepayments.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance priorities & milestone commitments

Sofia —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers inline: 

- Event classes: transaction metadata and user identifiers need 7 years; full request payloads can be retained for 1 year and then purged unless flagged.
- Ownership: procurement drives the contract; IT risk will own artifact intake and technical verification (that’s Marco).
- Evidence formats: procurement prefers PDF reports for attestation, IT risk wants raw logs in gzipped CSV/JSON for verification.

We can confirm a standing point of contact for evidence: marco.r@silvergatepayments.com.

The proposed 2027-06-14 10:00 PT works for procurement and IT risk. Please include a versioned DPA draft in the invite so procurement can pre-review.

Elena
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
SilverGate Payments

> On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 15:22 Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for taking time today...
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@silvergatepayments.com>, Elena Torres <elena@silvergatepayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance priorities & milestone commitments

Elena / Marco —

Great, thanks for the clarifications — that helps tighten the artifact map. Confirming next steps and owners from Redwood: 

- Sofia: produce SOC 2 artifact map (controls -> artifacts -> availability dates) by 2027-06-17.
- Marissa: commercial and SLA items, will follow up on any credit/SLA asks in parallel.
- Rishi: technical evidence pack and pen-test artifact list; can provide guidance on log export formats and redaction options by 2027-06-12.

I’ve attached the evidence intake template; Marco, please populate the required event classes column and indicate whether you need the raw payload preserved for 7 years or only metadata.

I’ll send a calendar invite for 2027-06-14 10:00 PT with the draft DPA attached (draft will be version v0.1).

Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rinaldi <marco.r@silvergatepayments.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance priorities & milestone commitments

Marco / Sofia —

Quick technical note ahead of the call:

- We can provide an audit-export endpoint that streams event classes into your S3 in newline-delimited JSON. Retention policies can be enforced on our side or left to your S3 lifecycle rules — both are possible.
- For 7-year retention of full request payloads we recommend server-side encryption + HSM-backed key rotation; I’ll outline options in the technical pack.
- Pen-test evidence: we have a redacted pen-test report (last dated 2027-02) and a remediation evidence bundle (config diff + ticket references). We will attach the redacted report to the invite.

If you have specific schema requirements for the export (field names, pseudonymization flags), send them to me and I’ll validate.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
